text.p: 50-Off Stores Inc said on Friday that its management was considering bankruptcy or selling the company in light of deteriorating results.
50-Off Stores said it would look for a strategic alliance or merger before resorting to selling the company or filing for bankruptcy.
It said management would abandon those plans if it found the capital it needed to change the concept of the company from off-pricing retailing to close-out retailing.
The change would involve liquidating or closing underperforming stores, it added.

50-Off Stores said net sales for the six months ending August 2 totalled $64.1 million against $87 million for the same period last year. Pre-tax loss totalled $7.7 million from a loss of $1.9 million as a result of the "the apparent consumer rejection of the 50-Off retailing concept in almost all its markets," it added.
